floater.name: floater_director
floater.title: Director Console

spinner.label: Delay (s)
spinner.name: delay_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Countdown before ACTION fires (s), so a solo operator can get into frame. 0 = immediately

combo_box.name: scene_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Load a scene: restores cast, marks, loco anims, subjects and parameters

line_editor.name: scene_name_editor
line_editor.tool_tip: Scene name. Enter or Save writes the file; an empty name cancels

button.label: Save
button.name: btn_scene_save
button.tool_tip: Save the whole setup as a scene

button.label: X
button.name: btn_scene_delete
button.tool_tip: Delete the selected scene file (asks to confirm)

check_box.label: Actor moves
check_box.name: arm_moves_check
check_box.tool_tip: ACTION starts a ghost walk for every cast member (you, if the cast is empty); CUT stops them

check_box.label: Camera
check_box.name: arm_camera_check
check_box.tool_tip: ACTION enables the cinematic camera pattern; CUT restores the enable state it changed

check_box.label: Recorder play
check_box.name: arm_play_check
check_box.tool_tip: ACTION starts Flycam Recorder playback of the loaded take; CUT stops it. Ignored while capture is also armed

check_box.label: Recorder capture
check_box.name: arm_capture_check
check_box.tool_tip: ACTION starts a fresh camera capture (replaces the current take); CUT stops it. Beats recorder play when both are armed

check_box.label: Show paths
check_box.name: show_paths_global_check
check_box.tool_tip: Global: draw the in-world path/heading preview for cast actors and enrolled props while a mover/Director floater is open. Client-side overlay only.

button.name: btn_help
button.tool_tip: Show a legend for the cast icons, A/B subjects, marks and path colors

scroll_list.name: cast_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: The cast: right-click a row for subjects, marks and more. Multi-select drives batch Move-tab ops. A member's group shows as a suffix after the name

floater.text: Right-click an avatar or animesh in world > Add to Cast

combo_box.name: group_assign_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Group tag for the selected member(s): type a new name or pick an existing one, Enter commits. Empty ungroups

button.label: + You
button.name: btn_add_you
button.tool_tip: Add your own avatar to the cast

button.label: Focus
button.name: btn_focus
button.tool_tip: Frame the selected cast member in the camera

button.label: + Animesh
button.name: btn_add_animesh
button.tool_tip: Add the in-world-selected animesh object(s) to the cast, so the Switchboard and Move tools can drive them. (Right-click an animesh > Director > Add to Cast does one at a time.)

scroll_list.name: groups_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: Every group with its member count and start delay. Select a row to highlight its members in the cast list and load the delay / rename fields below

spinner.label: Delay (s)
spinner.name: group_delay_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Start delay for the selected group (s): ACTION and Start group launch its members this many seconds late (staggered starts). 0 = immediate. Saved with the scene

button.label: Dissolve
button.name: btn_group_dissolve
button.tool_tip: Clear the selected group: every member is untagged (nobody is removed from the cast); its delay is dropped

line_editor.name: group_rename_editor
line_editor.tool_tip: New name for the selected group; Enter or Rename commits. Renaming onto an existing group merges them

button.label: Rename
button.name: btn_group_rename
button.tool_tip: Rename the selected group to the name on the left (retags every member)

panel.name: animate_scroll_content

scroll_list.name: anim_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: Animations currently signaled on the selected cast member. Right-click a row for actions

columns.label: Pri
columns.name: prio
columns.tool_tip: Animation priority when the motion is resolvable; ? otherwise

columns.label: On
columns.name: playing
columns.tool_tip: Marker: the animation is actually playing right now

panel.text: Select a cast member to see the animations playing on them
Play any animation on the selected member (client-side only):

line_editor.name: paste_uuid_editor
line_editor.tool_tip: Animation asset UUID. Paste one from the Animation Explorer or your inventory. Also previews below on loop

combo_box.name: play_local_priority_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Client-side priority both Play local actions use (the selected row and the pasted UUID). Local playback only; per-instance, so other avatars are unaffected. Baked keeps the animation's own priority; higher wins over lower when animations overlap.

text.name: loco_text
text.tool_tip: The selected member's locomotion override: the animation the mover plays while walking them

button.label: Open Animation Explorer
button.name: btn_open_animexp
button.tool_tip: Open the standalone Animation Explorer (recent-animation list, name lookups)

text.name: subject_a_text
text.tool_tip: Subject A: the CineCam / orbit anchor. Set from the cast list's right-click menu or the button

text.name: subject_b_text
text.tool_tip: Subject B: the second body for Two-Shot / Over-the-Shoulder

text.name: subject_c_text
text.tool_tip: Subject C: an additional camera-switcher target mark

text.name: subject_d_text
text.tool_tip: Subject D: an additional camera-switcher target mark

button.label: Actor Gaze...
button.name: btn_actor_gaze
button.tool_tip: Open Actor Gaze for camera look-at flagging, targeting, and performance controls

button.label: Virtual Cam...
button.name: btn_virtual_cam
button.tool_tip: Open Virtual Cam controls, camera switcher, and shot builders

button.label: Ultimate Diopter...
button.name: btn_ultimate_diopter
button.tool_tip: Open the Ultimate Diopter lens-front diopter and halo effect controls

combo_box.name: director_ps_preset
combo_box.tool_tip: Apply a complete projector-shaft starting point; Froxel/Voxel Air settings are not changed.

slider.name: director_projvol_temporal_reject
slider.tool_tip: Reduces history where the current and reprojected shaft disagree.

check_box.label: Track airborne beam depth
check_box.tool_tip: Reproject from the shaft's luminance-weighted mean distance instead of the wall.

check_box.label: Temporal anti-banding (no extra samples)
check_box.tool_tip: Cycles the static march phase only while temporal accumulation can average it.

slider.name: director_ps_wind_azimuth
slider.tool_tip: Wind compass bearing (0=N, 90=E), shared by froxel air and beam dust.

slider.name: director_ps_max_distance
slider.tool_tip: Maximum visible airborne beam length. 0 follows the projector's full light range; surface illumination is unchanged. Hover and scroll the mouse wheel for 0.1 m steps.

check_box.label: Soft projector shadows (contact-hardening + fill)
check_box.tool_tip: Widen projector shadow softness with receiver distance and add an ambient fill floor.

check_box.label: Gobo anisotropic/mip filtering (anti-alias)
check_box.tool_tip: Filter projector cookies so gobos stay crisp at distance and grazing angles.

panel.name: actor_style_scroll_content
panel.text: Style You or a Director cast member with shared or live-exclusive cinematic looks. Client-side only.

combo_box.name: actor_style_target
combo_box.tool_tip: Choose You or a Director cast member. An away actor keeps the style ready for when they return.

check_box.label: Enable actor styling
check_box.name: actor_style_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Master switch for this actor's client-side style

combo_box.name: actor_style_mode
combo_box.tool_tip: Layer blends the effect over the authored actor material. Cover fully owns the actor's visible material response while preserving authored alpha coverage, shadows, and motion.

combo_box.name: actor_style_look
combo_box.tool_tip: Shared Ghost Studio looks plus live-actor-exclusive cinematic treatments

check_box.label: Use actor hue
check_box.name: actor_style_use_actor_hue
check_box.tool_tip: Use the actor's stable Director path color. Uncheck to use Custom hue below.

slider.label: Custom hue
slider.name: actor_style_hue
slider.tool_tip: Tint hue in degrees when Use actor hue is off

slider.label: Effect opacity
slider.name: actor_style_alpha
slider.tool_tip: Opacity of the styled effect. Layer overlays the original actor; Cover controls the replacement opacity, where 0 makes the actor fully invisible. This does not control Dissolve coverage.

slider.label: Dissolve
slider.name: actor_style_dissolve_progress
slider.tool_tip: Dissolve progress: 0 keeps the actor whole; 1 removes it completely. Only available for the Dissolve look.

slider.label: Pixelate
slider.name: actor_style_pixel
slider.tool_tip: Screen-space pixelation block size in pixels; 0 is off

slider.label: Shimmer Hz
slider.name: actor_style_shimmer_speed
slider.tool_tip: Animation tempo for Bass Sweep and Possessed; shimmer rate for other looks when Shimmer amount is above zero

slider.label: Shimmer amt
slider.name: actor_style_shimmer_amount
slider.tool_tip: Brightness and alpha shimmer depth; 0 is off

slider.label: Glitch
slider.name: actor_style_glitch
slider.tool_tip: Broken-signal horizontal tear and chroma split; 0 is off

combo_box.name: actor_style_distortion
combo_box.tool_tip: Independent distortion layer; stacks with any selected look

slider.label: Distort amt
slider.name: actor_style_distortion_amount
slider.tool_tip: Strength of the selected independent distortion

slider.label: Brightness
slider.name: actor_style_brightness
slider.tool_tip: Output brightness of the styled branch; reduce it to sit the actor into a dark set

spinner.label: Effect fps
spinner.name: actor_style_effect_fps
spinner.tool_tip: Shader animation cadence. 0 is smooth; 1-30 holds animated looks for stop motion.

button.label: Reset actor style
button.name: actor_style_reset
button.tool_tip: Restore this actor's style defaults and turn styling off

text.name: rec_indicator
text.tool_tip: Recorder capture indicator: red while a take is being captured

panel.name: legend_panel
panel.text:
Status column: a walking figure means the actor is moving, a green dot means idle and in world, a gray dot means the actor is not in world (shown "(away)").
AB column: A marks Subject A and B marks Subject B, the bodies the cinematic camera frames. Set them from the cast right-click menu, the Camera tab, or by double-clicking a cast row (sets Subject A).
M column: a flag means a mark (a saved position) is set for that actor.
L column: L marks a cast member flagged for the Camera tab's local Look at camera override. The master toggle must also be on; ghosts and animesh are never affected.
Groups: the dot-suffix after a name is the member's group tag (set in the Group box under the list); the Move tab's Start/Stop group drive every member of a group at once.
Paths: each actor's in-world path preview and its numbered nodes are drawn in a stable per-actor color, so overlapping routes stay readable.
Hotkeys: F2 toggle console · F3 ACTION/CUT · F4 CUT · F5 reset to marks · F6 pose ghosts · F7 take play/pause · F8 set marks. While this console is visible and the switcher is armed, 1–9 punch slots 1–9. Disable via DirectorHotkeysEnabled.
